# TSBS DevOps — Metrics by Service

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

CPU metrics grouped by service

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    t.service,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.hostname) as host_count,
    AVG(c.usage_user + c.usage_system) as avg_cpu_total
FROM cpu c
JOIN tags t ON c.hostname = t.hostname
WHERE c.time >= '2024-01-02 17:00:00'
  AND c.time < '2024-01-02 18:00:00'
GROUP BY t.service
ORDER BY avg_cpu_total DESC
```
